title: Decent Espresso Dial-In Drift
dataSources: Beanconqueror brews (`beanconqueror:brew`), Acaia brew sessions (`acaia:brew`), Decent Espresso shots (`decent:shot`), Brewfather coffee recipes (`brewfather:coffee`), and tea-timer sessions (`teatimer:session`).
app: Beanconqueror brews, Acaia scale sessions, Decent Espresso shot telemetry, Brewfather coffee recipes, and tea-timer app exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=decent:shot espresso_profile=* extraction_yield_pct=* shot_seconds=*
| stats avg(extraction_yield_pct) as avg_yield, stdev(extraction_yield_pct) as yield_stdev, avg(shot_seconds) as avg_shot_seconds by espresso_profile
| eval yield_stdev=round(yield_stdev,2)
| sort - yield_stdev
description: Surfaces espresso profiles whose extraction yield is drifting or becoming inconsistent.
value: Dial-in drift wastes beans and hides grinder or puck-prep problems that are easier to fix when caught early.
implementation: Capture Decent shot telemetry for yield and shot time, then review profile-level variance after each bag of beans.
visualization: Table of espresso profiles ranked by extraction-yield variance.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which espresso recipes have started wandering away from the sweet spot instead of staying consistent.
